notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, favicon, and preview image, but has no description support.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but descriptions are unsupported.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable; description is missing.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate storage is prevented and edit targets are returned, but the normal preview flow uses a manual 303 response that the browser client cannot reliably read to navigate.
REF-BM-07: List cards show title and tags, but not description or the stored favicon.
REF-BM-08: Selecting the list title opens an internal detail page rather than the original URL.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a comma-separated text field without autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, note, and tags, but descriptions are unsupported.
REF-BM-15: Implicit AND, OR, and NOT work, but explicit AND is treated as text and parentheses are rejected.
REF-BM-20: No multiple-selection or bulk-action implementation exists.
REF-BM-21: No action can be applied to the entire current filtered collection.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot implementation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved-filter bundle entity or workflow exists.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No personal display-settings storage or UI exists.
